<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">EXPLANATORY
NOTE</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">This registration
statement on Form 10 (the &ldquo;Registration Statement&rdquo;) is being filed by Allied Energy, Inc. in order to register common stock
of the Company voluntarily pursuant to Section 12(g) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &ldquo;Exchange Act&rdquo;).
The Company is not required to file this Registration Statement pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &ldquo;Securities
Act&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">The Registration
Statement will become effective automatically by lapse of time 60 days from the date of the filing pursuant to Section 12(g)(1) of the
Exchange Act, or earlier if accelerated at the request of the Company. Once this Registration Statement is deemed effective, we will
be subject to the requirements of Regulation 13A under the Exchange Act, which will require us to file annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly
reports on Form 10-Q and current reports on Form 8-K, and we will be required to comply with all other obligations of the Exchange Act
applicable to issuers filing registration statements pursuant to Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act. The Registration Statement, including
exhibits, may be inspected without charge at the SEC&rsquo;s principal office in Washington, D.C., and copies of all or any part thereof
may be obtained from the Public Reference Section, Securities and Exchange Commission, 100 F Street, NW, Washington, D.C. 20549 upon
payment of the prescribed fees, if any. You may obtain information on the operation of the Public Reference Room by calling the SEC at
l.800.SEC.0330. The SEC maintains a website that contains reports, proxy and information statements and other information regarding registrants
that file electronically with it. The address of the SEC&rsquo;s Website is http://sec.gov.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>This
registration statement shall hereafter become effective in accordance with the provisions of section 8(a) of the Securities Act of 1933.</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">FORWARD
LOOKING STATEMENTS</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">There are
statements in this Registration Statement that are not historical facts. These &ldquo;forward-looking statements&rdquo; can be identified
by use of terminology such as &ldquo;believe,&rdquo; &ldquo;hope,&rdquo; &ldquo;may,&rdquo; &ldquo;anticipate,&rdquo; &ldquo;should,&rdquo;
&ldquo;intend,&rdquo; &ldquo;plan,&rdquo; &ldquo;will,&rdquo; &ldquo;expect,&rdquo; &ldquo;estimate,&rdquo; &ldquo;project,&rdquo; &ldquo;positioned,&rdquo;
&ldquo;strategy&rdquo; and similar expressions. You should be aware that these forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties
that are beyond our control. Although management believes that the assumptions underlying the forward-looking statements included in
this Registration Statement are reasonable, they do not guarantee our future performance, and actual results could differ from those
contemplated by these forward-looking statements. The assumptions used for purposes of the forward-looking statements specified in the
following information represent estimates of future events and are subject to uncertainty as to possible changes in economic, legislative,
industry, and other circumstances. As a result, the identification and interpretation of data, and other information, and their use in
developing and selecting assumptions from and among reasonable alternatives require the exercise of judgment. To the extent that the
assumed events do not occur, the outcome may vary substantially from anticipated or projected results, and, accordingly, no opinion is
expressed on the achievability of those forward-looking statements. In light of these risks and uncertainties, there can be no assurance
that the results and events contemplated by the forward-looking statements contained in this Registration Statement will in fact transpire.
You are cautioned not to place undue reliance on these forward-looking statements, which speak only as of their dates. We do not undertake
any obligation to update or revise any forward-looking statements.</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">INFORMATION
REQUIRED IN REGISTRATION STATEMENT</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><A NAME="a_002"></A>ITEM 1. DESCRIPTION OF
BUSINESS</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Allied Energy,
Inc. (&ldquo;Allied Energy&rdquo;, the &ldquo;Company,&rdquo; &ldquo;us&rdquo; or &ldquo;we&rdquo;) through its subsidiaries, operates
an AI driven social commerce platform that facilitates monetization between social media influencers and brands. The platform enables
influencers to share and sell products they endorse, while offering brands access to an extensive network of influencers to promote and
distribute their products.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Allied Energy,
Inc. (OTC: AGGI) is an investment holding company headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Focused on identifying and nurturing high-potential
businesses across various sectors, Allied Energy aims to create long-term value for its shareholders through strategic acquisitions and
partnerships. The Company has one direct subsidiary Metamexx Corp. and one indirect wholly owned subsidiary, BILI, Inc. (&ldquo;BILI&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">BILI is
an indirect subsidiary of Allied Energy, Inc. BILI, BecauseILoveIt.com, is an emerging AI powered social commerce platform that empowers
individuals to monetize their social media content by connecting creators with brands, enabling them to create personalized online stores
and maximize their earning potential by leveraging their social media presence. Through BILI Boost&trade;, the platform also facilitates
dynamic collaborations between creators and brands, allowing influencers to craft unique branded content and earn compensation for their
creativity. BILI&rsquo;s innovative approach ensures that creators can turn their passion into profit, while brands benefit from authentic,
impactful partnerships. As of September of 2025, BILI has 37,000 engaged users/creators, and 2,150 engaged brand contacts. The term &ldquo;engaged,&rdquo;
includes, but is not limited to BILI platform registered profiles, BILI platform users, BILI clients, BILI active customer relationship
(CRM) contacts including email, social media, etc.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Current
Products and Services.</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">To achieve
BILI&rsquo;s mission of effectively and efficiently connecting brands and social media influencers BILI offers the services outlined
below.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>BILI
Base&trade;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">BILI Base&trade;
available at https://BILI.Social is the AI powered social commerce platform where we enable creators
to sell products, where each creator effectively becomes a retailer. This concept is modelled off established practices in Asia where
influencer driven commerce is common. In North America, X (formerly Twitter), recently announced a partnership with VISA to enable FIAT
wallets inside the platform which we believe will enable payments between creators and shoppers. We expect this to be copied by other
social media platforms, reducing the barriers between social commerce. BILI Base&trade;&rsquo;s AI powered social commerce platform is
designed to harness this change.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We secure
distribution deals with brands and manufacturers to sell products through the BILI Base &trade; platform. Brands pay us a 9.9% transaction
fee, and creators earn an additional 10-30% commission. We believe this pricing model is cost effective when compared to traditional
retail pricing, where brands have to pay retailers approximately 50-60% of the purchase price, our model leaves brands with a larger
stake of each sale.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>BILI
Boost&trade;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">There are
an estimated 10+ million influencers in North America, (and many more worldwide) and we believe we have data on every one of them. Most
Fortune 500 brands aren&rsquo;t interested in the estimated 10 million influences. They are interested in the 100, 10 or 1 that fit their
campaign perfectly. Our AI enabled search engine and filtering allows for almost instant identification of suitable creators to help
brands promote and sell their products. Our &lsquo;white glove&rsquo; process identifies these creators, benchmarks pricing, engagement
and reach metrics, and then enables seamless contracting to have these creators develop and share brand content.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 4 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We structure
all BILI Boost&trade; engagements with our unique proprietary guaranteed results process called the BILI Benchmark whereby clients receive
a guaranteed number of views against their target audience. We track views as measured by social media platforms such as Instagram and
Tik Tok. We use several inputs to guarantee the BILI Benchmark including but not limited to:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Influencer auditing with 150+ points of data to select optimal
influencers.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Cost benchmarking to negotiate fair deals.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Rigorous content creation processes and best practices.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Real-time automated monitoring of live content performance and
optimization across creators, content, platforms and posts to optimize results.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Paid amplification of creator posts targeted towards a brand&rsquo;s
agreed target audience.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We believe
that this unique structure will help secure new brand partnerships and scale business growth.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We earn
a fixed service fee for sourcing creators and for managing the content creation paid amplification.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>BILI
Boost+&trade;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">BILI Boost+&trade;
is the enhanced version of BILI Boost&trade; that has all the features of BILI Boost&trade; but adds the layer of enhanced targeting
of paid amplification by targeting the social media posts based on actual past purchase behavior of social media consumers. For example,
a brand can amplify their social media posts towards people who have purchased a competitive product in the last 6 months. BILI Boost
+&trade; fees are charged at a premium of 15-35% over BILI Boost&trade;.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">BILI Academy</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">As part
of our services, we also train creators during their onboarding process to maximize the efficiency and effectiveness of their engagement
with brands and with their audiences.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Company
Divisions and Objectives</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">As we advance
our plan of operation, we believe we should focus our efforts on the pursuit, research and development of the following tools, objectives,
partnerships and relationships in order to achieve success:</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>AI</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We first
implemented AI into our practices and platforms in early 2023 after the first launch of Chat GPT. AI was used to assist creators in developing
social media captions, and tests showed an increase of 28% in engagement (likes, shares, comments, views) on our creators&rsquo; AI enhanced
content. Since then, we have continued to utilize, develop and implement AI into practices, the platform, our products and services,
and campaigns to drive greater efficiency and increased effectiveness. We believe that the ongoing implementation and integration of
AI will continue to drive the differentiation and success of our business.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Connecting
Asia and North America</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Many Asian
manufacturers are actively looking to expand sales internationally, including into North America. We believe that our data on 7 Million+
creators, plus weekly engagement with tens of thousands of creators is a compelling audience for these Asian manufacturers. As such,
our Asia team is actively promoting and selling to these manufacturers access to BILI Base&trade;, BILI Boost&trade; and BILI Boost+&trade;
services. We believe that the pursuit of a mutually satisfactory business relationship with Asian manufactures represents a strategic
benefit and significant opportunity to scale our business.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 5 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->5<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Sports
and Entertainment</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We will
provide brands with direct access to thousands of amateur, pro and retired athletes, which we believe is more than almost any competitor
in North America has to offer. We have established this network through industry leading partnerships such as our &ldquo;Exclusive Social
Commerce&rdquo; Partnership with the NHL (National Hockey League) Alumni Association and the &ldquo;Exclusive Social Commerce Partnership&rdquo;
with the CFL (Canadian Football League) Union. These exclusive partnerships enable us to provide athlete driven BILI Boost&trade;, BILI
Boost+&trade; and BILI Base&trade; offerings to brands that we believe many competitors are unable to match. We aim to expand these partnerships
to other sports including but not limited to basketball, soccer, baseball and the lucrative and expanding eSports segments.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Properties
&amp; Equipment</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Currently,
our office space is located in a leased office space located at 104-360 College Street Suite #251, Toronto, ONT M5T 1S6, Canada which
we believe is sufficient for our present needs. Additionally, the Company currently has assets that consist of solely intellectual property,
know-how, and previously developed and cultivated relationships that we believe will facilitate our plan of operations as we move forward.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Paths
to Revenue</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Allied Energy,
Inc. has identified various avenues to generate revenue, capitalizing on our platform, and the influencer marketing industry.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We generate
revenues by both earning a fixed service fee for sourcing creators and for managing the content creation paid amplification through our
BILI Boost&trade; and BILI Boost+&trade; products, and via sales commissions collected from sales generated through our BILI Base&trade;
platform.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Target
Market in the US</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.75in; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 20%; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><U>Target Market</U></B></FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 3%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 77%; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B><U>Description</U></B></FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-left: 6.9pt; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Enterprise Brands</B></FONT></TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Fortune 500+ brands with marketing budgets ranging from $50-500 Million allocated to social media, influencers, PR, etc. Brands looking to drive awareness are suitable for BILI Boost&trade; services. Brands looking to drive sales are suitable for BILI Base&trade;. &nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Small and Medium Brands </B></FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Businesses with marketing budgets ranging from $2-50 Million allocated to social media, influencers, PR, etc. Brands looking to drive awareness are suitable for BILI Boost&trade; services. Brands looking to drive sales are suitable for BILI Base&trade;. &nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Commerce Creators</B></FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Creators with content focused on selling products and services. Sometimes referred to as &lsquo;Affiliate,&rsquo; these creators focus on messages and content to promote and recommend specific products with the intent of selling, usually with direct links to the brand, or in BILI&rsquo;s case a creators personalized store link through BILI Base&trade;. These creators are suitable for BILI Base&trade; and BILI&rsquo;s AI processes and tools to help match creators with brands, products and to help creators develop text and video content. &nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>Content Creators</B></FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Creators who develop content focused on promoting products and services. These creators focus on messages and content to raise general awareness of a business or their products and services. These creators are suitable for BILI Boost&trade; and BILI&rsquo;s AI processes and tools to help creators develop text and video content. Often BILI also applies paid advertising behind this content to increase the reach and effectiveness for a brand. &nbsp;</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Industry
Overview &amp; Competitive Landscape</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">The social
commerce and influencer marketing landscape is undergoing a dramatic transformation, fueled by shifting consumer behaviors, platform
consolidation, and the rise of AI. BILI operates at the intersection of <B>content, commerce, and creator empowerment</B>, positioning
itself uniquely between traditional influencer networks and next-generation social commerce platforms.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">We face
intense competition from platforms and agencies that span across <B>creator discovery, campaign management, content development, and
monetization infrastructure</B>. Many of our competitors are significantly better capitalized and more established, giving them structural
advantages in scale, brand recognition, and market access.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Market
Trends</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">According
to market data, forecasts and external research gathered by the Company, we believe that there are currently five major trends that define
the current and future state of our industry:</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>1.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT>AI-Powered Personalization</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Platforms
like LTK, Yotpo, and Bazaarvoice are increasingly leveraging AI for influencer matchmaking, return on investment prediction, and content
optimization. AI also powers virtual influencers and synthetic media.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>2.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT>Commerce-Driven Content</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Creators
are no longer just storytellers, rather they are storefronts. Brands are investing in shoppable video, augmented reality-powered try-ons,
affiliate integrations, and trackable creator links to drive measurable conversions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 7 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->7<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>3.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT>Rise of the Professional Creator</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Creators
are evolving into entrepreneurs by offering services like coaching, launching their own brands, and monetizing via multiple streams (e.g.,
equity deals, direct-to-fan tools).</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>4.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT>Platform Consolidation &amp; Vertical Specialization</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">There is
a trend toward consolidation and specialization: Goat was acquired by WPP, and smaller players are focusing on verticals like fitness,
fashion, or sustainability. This creates space for purpose-built platforms like BILI to grow.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>5.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
</FONT>Community-Led Discovery &amp; Social SEO</I></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Platforms
like TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube Shorts are becoming search engines. Influencer content is driving product discovery, and brands are
optimizing for &ldquo;social search&rdquo; over traditional SEO.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Strengths
&amp; Opportunities for BILI</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Global Recognition:</I> BILI recently received 3 awards at
the global BOLD awards in Lisbon, Portugal recognizing excellence in tech, design, impact and creativity. This established BILI as a
leader amongst global peers.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Vertical Focus:</I> Few competitors have verticalized influencer
matching. BILI&rsquo;s specialization in categories like <B>wellness, fashion, fitness</B>, or <B>social impact </B>could differentiate
it meaningfully.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Democratization of Tools:</I> By offering accessible creator
onboarding, reporting dashboards, and performance tools for both creators and brands, BILI can position itself as an enabler for mid-tier
and emerging creators.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>AI Integration Potential</I>: There's significant opportunity
to build or integrate lightweight AI solutions for creator scoring, content guidance, and dynamic pricing to match or outpace competitors.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Social Commerce Partnerships</I>: BILI can create integrations
with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce) or affiliate platforms to drive conversion-oriented campaigns.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Education as Differentiator</I>: Programs like the BILI Academy
can upskill creators while reinforcing brand trust. This component is rarely emphasized by larger players.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Weaknesses
&amp; Threats</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Capital Disadvantage</I>: Competitors like CreatorIQ, Viral
Nation, and Bazaarvoice have raised substantial funding and built large enterprise sales teams.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Measurement Challenges</I>: Like all participants in this
space, BILI must address cross-platform return on investment attribution, fake follower filtering, and campaign effectiveness transparency.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Noise &amp; Fragmentation</I>: With so many platforms and
creators, BILI will need to stand out with superior user experience or UX, clearer positioning, or a breakthrough partner campaign.</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD>
</TR>
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 20pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><I>Audience Maturity</I>: Consumers are savvier which can cause
traditional macro-influencer campaigns to underperform. Micro/nano influencers require scalable tools, which many competitors are already
building.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Proprietary
Rights</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Proprietary
rights are crucial to our success and competitive position. We rely on intellectual property and trade secret laws, confidentiality procedures,
and contractual provisions to evolve and secure our proprietary rights.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">As of September
30, 2025, we owned 2 trademarks in Canada and have 3 pending, as well as 2 pending trademark applications in the U.S. As of Sept 30,
2025, we also own approximately 15 domain names related to our platform and our products and services.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">The service
agreements that we execute with our creators include intellectual property provisions whereby we acquire ownership rights to all content
generated by creators with the right to use and post such content.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt"><B>Employees</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Currently,
we employ 13 individuals (excluding officers, directors and key advisors):</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Operations</I>:
3 full time employees responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Company, including project coordination and logistics.
These individuals dedicate an average of 40 hours per week.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Sales
and Marketing</I>: 4 full time employees focus on business development, client acquisition, and promoting the Company&rsquo;s services.
Their roles include outreach and engagement with potential partners and stakeholders. These employees spend approximately 40 hours per
week in these efforts.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Finance</I>:
1 full time employee who manages the Company&rsquo;s financial operations, including accounting, financial planning, and compliance.
This individual also works 40 hours per week.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 20pt; text-indent: 0pt"><I>Tech
and Development</I>: 5 full time employees manage the Company&rsquo;s technical, web and commerce platform development.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">Each employee
contributes to the Company&rsquo;s operational efficiency and growth.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">In addition
to the above, we outsource numerous tasks such as content development, to independent contractors on an as needed basis. Presently, we
have approximately 5 individuals who perform work for us on an independent contractor basis.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt">In addition
